desc: The B5 Systems AK stock (4.5mm and 5.5mm variants) offers a drop-in upgrade for the factory folding stock and mounts by the factory pin to the folding trunnion. It features improved ergonomics, an adjustable length of pull, QD/fixed sling mounts, optic rail cutout and a cushioned buttpad. Proudly made in the USA of composite materials and steel hardware.
